style.prompt:
Design a cheerful community picnic flyer, polished flat vector illustration and beautifully legible typography. Sunny butter yellow background, sky blue and leafy green, small coral accents. Little illustrated daisies and other simple flowers, leaves, tiny picnic motifs framing the edges, generous clean central space. Centered four-line text hierarchy with large friendly bold headline. Render exactly these four lines, no quotes, no extra text or letters anywhere:
Community Picnic
12 June 2027
12:00–15:00
Maple Park, East Gate
Preserve exact capitalization, punctuation, and the en dash in the time. Headline largest, date second, time and location clearly legible. Keep all flowers and text within a central portrait 4:5 safe area so the design can be adapted to 4:5 without loss. Warm, welcoming, uncluttered professional graphic design.
